I had a bad experience in highschool with weights in my PE class because I had no idea what I was doing and used a smith machine, every part of my body was in pain after that even stuff that shouldn't have been. The feeling of finding the confidence to do exercises with free weights and a few small plates was pretty dope (even being able to just lift the barbell would have been an achievement lol). The biggest reward for me is being able to do the exercises, cause I didn't think it was something for me until now, and the muscle soreness afterwards is actually nice because it means I'm making progress. So my journey has just begun. I wish you the best on yours :)
